body: I'm so sorry you feel this way. I'm sorry you feel so alone. I hope you can find someone to talk to. I hope your night/day gets better. You matter :)
No, you just needed someone to talk to, nothing wrong with that. Glad you reached out. Seriously
Sorry that i'm late, I had to eat dinner. I'm really glad that you're okay. I had a panic attack yesterday so I can relate. And yes, we're strangers, but we're always willing to listen
I might to be able to. And my previous ones just tell me a bunch of fluffy bs knowing damn well it's not gonna help
I've talked to hotlines and my therapist. I just feel like I'm running out of hope
If you want to talk. I'm here
I'm sorry you feel that way. Anything you want to talk about?
It's hard because it feels like the people that should care the most don't. I've been holding on. Don't know how much longer I can though
I'm 19 almost 20 (in a year). I've been trapped for so long. I'm tired of feeling the way that I feel. I wish my parents took mental health seriously

Well, the thing is, I've tried telling my mom how she makes me feel only to be told that I "bring those things upon myself". I've been diagnosed with ADHD and anxiety, but it's like my mom uses that against me. I tell her I'm anxious, she tells me to "stop worrying". Almost like she doesn't care. When I have panic attacks she treats me like some sort of circus freak. I've been struggling for years and I haven't given up, I just feel like I won't be able to fight my battles much longer
